pirs.statement: Is HD03130 a binding legislative decision or a take-note accountability report, and what is its decision pathway?
pirs.answer_summary: HD03130 is a skrivelse (Skr. 2025/26:130) — a take-note accountability report on the AP buffer funds referred to Finansutskottet. The Riksdag notes it rather than legislating; no binding substantive vote occurs.
